Cabin crew · Kenya

David Kimotho and John Muchina

flydubai Flight 10732026Developing story
Flight
flydubai Flight 1073
Date
30 September 2026
Aircraft
Boeing 737 MAX 8
Location
Tabuk, Saudi Arabia

flydubai Flight 1073 on 30 September 2026 is still under investigation, so details of what David Kimotho and John Muchina did may change as more is confirmed.

Lead flight attendant David Kimotho and his colleague John Muchina, both from Kenya, gave first aid to Captain Smit Machchhar as he lay bleeding on the cabin floor of flydubai Flight 1073 after the cockpit attack, speaking to each other in Swahili as they checked on him and kept him talking. Kimotho also kept order in the cabin, telling panicking passengers to sit down. The UAE's aviation authority praised the crew's "remarkable courage and speed of response".

Who helped

Besides David Kimotho and John Muchina, 9 people helped on flydubai Flight 1073. What each of them did, with sources, is on Smit Machchhar's page.

  • Smit Machchhar Captain
  • Tali Manes Passenger
  • Tzvika Manes Passenger
  • Yaniv Hayun Passenger
  • Asaf Rajuan Passenger
  • Dr Shota Musayev Passenger (dentist)
  • Two off-duty flydubai pilots Off-duty crew
  • David Kimotho Lead flight attendant (purser)
  • John Muchina Cabin crew
